latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Caption Generator from Audio.
- Upload audio or video files (MP3, MP4, WAV, M4A up to 500MB) and generate synced captions automatically.
- Fast cloud processing—captioned videos delivered in 30–60 seconds, no installation required.
- Automatic backend connection and user-friendly status updates.
- Supports credits, export, and session state management.
- Ideal for podcasters, content creators, and educators seeking quick, accurate captions without manual transcription.
